title: Audit the selected BIT child coefficient's numerical lifetime
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2781 explicitly excludes the recursive-child branch of PR2697's coefficient entry point. This closes that branch's occupied-numerical-content and restoration implication, covering two simultaneous Callbacks, the serialized extension, leaf evaluation, optional negative inverse and cleanup:

```text
numeric.selected_coefficient -> children.coefficient
additional residue Words <= 20,494
additional index Words   <= 22
```

Both bounds are above **all entry numerical residents** and attained separately by literal 64-dimensional executions. Together with Nick Petalas's credited adapter audit, either branch fits his existing 37,672/22 allowance. The written all-admitted-depth implication retains explicit arithmetic/program contracts. This is not total caller reserve, physical placement, supplier admission or a new kappa.

## Task and overlap

Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, adversarial-audit, refined to the child branch left open in #2781. Initial canonical main `6ca6f217708b075814de409ad693fea9a2aaa760`; rebased to refreshed main `84f8e607779b81c05edc962d4981d1f9b4b9bc9f`. Revision 5, guidance, selection, runner and scientific sources were unchanged. Nonce, scope, pins and freshness are in `research/selected-child-numerical-lifecycle/TASK.json`.

Scientific dependency: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml #2697 at `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1`. Exact #2770/#2781 proof texts are retained; seven runtime modules and the complete notice are byte-identical. This complements the active physical Frame/bank and compatible-row-padding work.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959528). Final complete metadata pagination covered 724 open PRs including drafts and 1,435 Discussion/comment/reply records, plus local notes, without warnings. It excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

## Validation

Native Windows, standard-library CPython 3.12.14:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-child-numerical-lifecycle
```

Registered replay passes after rebasing: eight literal fixtures, both excess attainments, independent integer coefficient oracles, every allocation budget, borrowed values/heads, repeated calls and actual source erasure of extensions/continuations. Twelve optimized groups pass, including one-Word-underbudget failures and source rollback after completed evaluation, checked before fixture teardown.

Git-free normal/optimized replay passes with unchanged file hashes; CPython 3.14.6 optimized primary also passes. Ten staged source/proof exports match their original hashes. Metadata/pins and whitespace checks pass. TEMP/TMP were redirected to writable workspace scratch for Windows relocation tests.

No full selected cold replay, selected GL64 Boolean payload, physical compiler, formal-kernel, hosted-CI or independent human review is claimed.

## Credit

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's #2697 implementation and retained notice; Nick Petalas's #2759/#2770 primitive/evaluator and #2778/#2781 construction/adapter work; David Arias's #2753 coarser logical inventory; and their preserved source/supplier lineage. This contribution joins the remaining closed child branch. Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Instantiate all L_R/L_I entry residents at one actual caller/route site, then join numerical content to serialized programs/stacks, backing slots, markers, grants, movement and physical placement. The package provides bounded first steps and blockers. Stronger H2, outer borrowing and complete reserve admission remain open.

## Merge danger

Two-way, research only: one additive opt-in package. Frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are unchanged. Applying its allowance to a whole caller still needs the separate entry-resident and physical-cost ledger.
